text.en:
Today you learn to say what people do.
Like work, live, start and need.
I work nearby.
It means: my work is close to here.
We start early.
It means: we begin when the day is young.

With I, you, we and they, the word stays short.
I work nearby. We work nearby.
With one other person, add s.
She works nearby. He lives alone.
A thing counts as one, too.
The shop opens at nine.

You will pick the right word for each person.
Look at who the sentence is about.
Is it I, we, you or they? Keep the short word.
Is it she, he or one thing? Add s.
Some words change a little more.
He finishes late. She studies at home.
